design.note: Geometric candidate; slicing and removal validation required

body_change.reason: Bed-rooted fin search could not reach these local native starts without body collision. The continuous underside chamfer is anchored to actual previous-layer printed bead footprints and extends until its plane fully clears the local region. Only small underside corners are trimmed; actual neighboring hardware actual neighboring hardware envelopes are protected; for nuts, central planar bearing and anti-rotation faces are protected and any corner relief needs separate face-by-face retention checks. Washer-entry chamfers are accepted only after retaining at least 98% of contact area and the entire outer 1 mm bearing ring and depth.

chamfers.tip_fragment_policy: Only newly separated fragments below 0.01 mm3 each and 0.02 mm3 total, outside protected hardware, are included in the cut; all removed material is subsequently checked against assembly contacts.

portal_panels_added.removal_instruction: Cut teeth first; cut the orange crown into sections, then remove the two bed-rooted legs and transverse buttresses independently. Do not pry against the blue joint seats.

geometry.label: portal88
geometry.removal_policy: All fin components start at the bed. Wide portal panels route around intervening body material using independently checked 45-degree layer growth; they never rely on the body for their roots. Sever yellow teeth, cut the orange portal crown into separate sections, then remove the legs, buttresses and base joins. This is a cut-apart support frame, not a guaranteed single-direction extraction. Empty assembly clearances must be fully cleaned before assembly.

portal_layer_growth.method: Every fin-only cross-section, without any body material as backing, must grow by no more than one layer height in XY plus 0.015 mm geometric tolerance. Every material island must overlap the preceding fin slice. All physical fin components separately must start at the bed. Portal panels are at least 3.2 mm thick; low single-root panels have broad recorded bed footprints, and taller portals have transverse buttresses.

fit.label: portal88
fit.baseline_body_policy: Frozen F3 print mesh is authoritative. Recorded bed and owner transforms register it against the unchanged assembly hardware. Differences from regenerated assembly body are reported, not attributed to this change.
fit.proof_scope: New body is a subset of the validated computational reference in the same rigid coordinate frame. A registered_congruent_reference, when present, uses an independently measured congruent source boundary within 0.0001 mm to avoid a second numerically unstable Boolean regeneration; its frozen source and printed reference hashes are verified. Where nominal_reference_recovery is present, the reference is the unchanged analytic O22 CAD with separately measured sub-0.0001 mm boundary agreement to the frozen print mesh. This proves no new geometric interference under any rigid pose. It does not prove stress/fatigue equivalence or the retention of every contact; actual assembly contacts and axis-limit samples are separately listed.
fit.pose_qualification_scope: Subtraction proves no new interference at any rigid pose. Base assembly contacts and sampled initially nonintersecting contacts are protected. Samples already intersecting in the unchanged assembly are reported separately; they are not certified as achievable poses.
